messages:
olivia: Need quick alignment on rollout approach for the early-adopter A/B for the new fallback policy. customer asks are coming in, want safe default.

maya: +1. what's the target cohort size for the early adopters?

olivia: starting with 1% org-wide, then expand to 10% if latency and error metrics hold. also will expose a per-tenant opt-in flag for customers who requested deterministic pinning.

tariq: For the 1% canary, prefer region-aware sampling — EU customers in eu-west only, US in us-west. reduces cross-region noise.

jamie: Agree. Need explicit latency budget: 99th <= 350ms or we don't expand. Also track tail error rate and token-cost delta.

luis: What are the precise rollback gates? i.e., which metric thresholds trigger immediate kill-switch vs. paused ramp?

maya: Proposal: immediate rollback if 99p latency regresses by >40% or error rate (5xx) increases >0.5% absolute. Pause and investigate if cost per token increases by >20% for sustained 5m window.

olivia: That seems fair. Add a human-in-loop for pause decisions (oncall + PM). We want automatic kill-switch for severe infra/customer impact only.

sre-bot: Deploybot: scheduled canary start at 2025-11-12T15:00Z, traffic slice = 1%.

tariq: For telemetry, we'll need these dashboards before start: latency-by-region, errors-by-tenant, cost-per-token, and rerank-quality (qual tests). Can ops own the dashboard links?

jamie: I'll put together a minimal dashboard. Also adding an eval harness: run 500 prompts/tenant through both control and fallback for semantic regressions. Use threshold AUC drop < 0.015 to proceed.

luis: How do we handle customer-driven pinning? customers want to pin to v1 for 3 months while others move to v2 fallback. We need per-tenant routing + safety for pinned tenants.

maya: Supported via feature flag: routing.pin_version = "v1" on tenant metadata. Routing layer will read it and bypass fallback. Example flag config: 
```json
{
  "flag": "tenant_pin",
  "scope": "tenant",
  "values": {"default": null, "override": "v1"},
  "expires_at": "2026-02-01T00:00:00Z"
}
```

olivia: Okay. Ops note: pinned tenants still count toward capacity. we should surface quota warnings if pinned set grows.

tariq: For A/B buckets: prefer deterministic hashing on tenant_id so experiments don't flip users. Use 0-9999 modulo for slices.

jamie: Also add an observability tag on logs: "fallback_experiment": "ea1" so we can slice traces easily.

luis: For rollout timeline: canary start -> 24h stability window -> 72h extended observation at 10% -> decision gate. PM to sign off at each gate.

olivia: I'll own sign-offs. Can we add quick runbook steps for the oncall? i.e., how to flip the kill-switch and revert routing rules.

maya: Draft runbook snippet: 
1) /toggle-flag fallback-global false (in featureflags UI)
2) POST /admin/routing/reload to ensure new rules pick up
3) Scale down fallback pool via infra-job: `infractl scale pool fallback-pool 0`
4) Notify affected customers and create incident if >5% tenant impact

olivia: Perfect. Final ask: add a tiny opt-in A/B UI for sales to register customers (manual opt-in). we'll wire an internal form -> tenant metadata update.

tariq: I'll add a narrow API endpoint for that and logs for audit.

sre-bot: Alert: if 99p latency > 350ms for 3 consecutive 1-minute windows, paging oncall.

jamie: I'll add the quality eval results to the release checklist. Also plan a fallback variant that reduces decoding length if token-cost spikes (cheap-fallback).

luis: One more: document customer SLA implications for pinned tenants. PM legal review?

olivia: Yep, I'll loop in legal + customer-ops after this thread. Thanks all — I'll post the rollout checklist and sign-off doc by EOD.
